title: Operation.
officialText:
Type I hood systems shall be designed and installed to automatically activate the exhaust fan whenever cooking
operations occur. The activation of the exhaust fan shall occur through an interlock with the cooking appliances, by means of heat
sensors or by means of other approved methods. Commercial cooking appliances equipped with integral down draft exhaust shall
meet the requirements of Section 507.2.
